prompt:

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: I am looking for an AI powered shopping mean list app
This is what I would need: First, you can either select the meal you wish to eat or search for a specific dish within the app. Once you've made your selection, the app will display the exact ingredients you'll need to purchase at the supermarket as well as a step-by-step guide on how to cook the dish using artificial intelligence. Ideally, the meal selection will also come with a picture to give you an idea of what to expect.
</job>

(none)

text:
You need an AI-powered shopping and meal app that lets users pick or search for a dish, then generates the exact ingredients to buy and a step-by-step cooking guide, ideally with an image of the finished meal.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be a great fit for this build. I have 7 years of experience working across full stack development with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. For a product like this, I’d focus on making the experience fast, intuitive, and genuinely useful from the first tap.

My approach would be to build a clean meal discovery flow where users can either browse meals or search for a specific dish. From there, the app would surface a clear ingredient list tailored to the selected recipe, along with a guided cooking experience generated with AI. I’d also make sure the UI presents the meal in a polished way, including a visual preview so users know what to expect before they start cooking.

On the technical side, I’d structure the app for reliability and easy expansion. That means a solid backend for meal data, ingredient generation, and AI-powered instructions, plus a frontend that feels smooth on both desktop and mobile. I’d also keep the user journey simple: select meal, review ingredients, follow cooking steps, and save or revisit favorites later if needed.

I pay close attention to product flow and clarity, especially in apps where users need quick answers and minimal friction. For this kind of project, that means making sure the ingredient list is easy to understand, the cooking steps are clearly ordered, and the AI output stays practical rather than vague.

If you’d like, I can help you shape the feature set and turn this into a polished app that feels both smart and easy to use.
